case_title: Brijendra Singh & Ors. v. State of Rajasthan
evidence_type: Documentary, statements under Section 161 Cr.P.C., medical records
neutral_facts: The accused were summoned by the court under Section 319 Cr.P.C. to face trial alongside other accused persons. The police investigation revealed that the accused were in Jaipur at the time of the incident, which occurred in Karauli, approximately 176 km away. The complainant and others claimed the accused were present at the incident location, but the police found their statements doubtful due to documentary evidence supporting the accused's alibi. The trial court relied on the complainant's and others' statements without considering the evidence showing the accused were in Jaipur. The High Court also failed to address the material evidence presented by the appellants.
